title: Skills enforcement state (v1)
description: Per-consumer choice of which playbook skills participate in materialise_skills. Disabled skills are NOT mirrored to `.claude/skills/`, `.gemini/skills/`, or `.cursor/rules/`. Negative-list (opt-out) by design: omitted skills default to enforced. Lives at `<consumer>/.ai-playbook-state/skills-enforce.json`. Written by `scripts/apply_config.py`, read by `scripts/materialise_skills.py`. Unknown slugs in `disabled` are tolerated and ignored (no validation against the live skills inventory) so a renamed-upstream skill never breaks a consumer's bundle.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Const for the v1 lifecycle.

disabled.description: Skill slugs (directory names under `skills/`) that MUST NOT be materialised on this consumer. Order is not significant. Empty array = all skills enforced (the default).

items.description: Skill slug matching the directory name. Lowercase kebab-case.

applied_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last apply_config write. Informational; readers do not act on it.

applied_by.description: Optional human/CI identifier of the operator who applied the bundle. Informational.
